properties.name: The run converter is renamed so a test glob never runs it, and refuses a log with no test target instead of reporting zero files
properties.rationale: Corrected at the cause, not contained. Both met while feeding reflow2's own run back (fact:reflow2s-own-real-run-was-fed-back-for-the-first-time-78-checks-agree-231-test-files-map-to-nothing). The name made every test_*.py glob record the converter's usage error as a failed test — fixed at the name rather than excluded at each call site. The empty log was read as 'files: 0', indistinguishable from nothing to report — now refused.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: tools/test_run_to_files.py → tools/run_to_files.py (its tests take tools/test_run_to_files.py); ci.yml and AGENTS.md gate lines, the reconcile tool's field doc, and the design's artifact locations follow. A --cargo source with no 'Running' line now exits 2 by name.
